menuPage.title: Freshly Crafted for You
menuPage.subtitle: Every item made fresh to order, the Jaby way.

items.name: 1kg Chocolate Cake
items.description: Deep, dark, and unapologetically rich — this chocolate cake is baked fresh with premium cocoa and layered with silky chocolate ganache for that first-bite moment everyone remembers. Moist, dense, and finished with a glossy chocolate drip, it's the kind of cake that turns a normal Tuesday into an occasion. Whether it's a birthday, a surprise, or just because — this one delivers every single time.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Red Velvet Cupcakes (6pcs)
items.description: Soft, blush-red cupcakes with just a whisper of cocoa, crowned with thick, tangy cream cheese frosting swirled to perfection. Each bite is pillowy-light with a subtle richness that keeps you reaching for another. A box of 6 that disappears faster than you'd expect.

items.name: Vanilla Celebration Cake
items.description: Classic never gets old — this vanilla sponge is baked golden and tender, layered with smooth, dreamy buttercream that melts on the tongue. It's the timeless favorite that suits every celebration, from milestone birthdays to quiet Sunday treats. Simple, elegant, and always a crowd-pleaser.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Black Forest Cake
items.description: Layers of moist chocolate sponge, whipped cream, and juicy cherries come together in this German classic done the Jaby way. Every slice delivers that perfect balance of rich chocolate and bright fruity sweetness, finished with chocolate shavings for good measure. A showstopper that photographs as well as it tastes.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Chocolate Fudge Cake
items.description: For the true chocolate lover — this is our most indulgent cake, packed with dense fudge layers and finished with a thick, glossy fudge coating. Every bite is deep, dark, and decadently rich, built for people who never say no to extra chocolate. Not for the faint of heart.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Strawberry Delight Cake
items.description: Light, fluffy sponge infused with real strawberry flavor and finished with a cloud of fresh cream and juicy strawberry pieces. It's bright, fruity, and refreshingly not-too-sweet — the cake that makes any table feel a little more special. A best-seller for good reason.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Carrot Cake
items.description: Warmly spiced, packed with grated carrots and toasted walnuts, and finished with tangy cream cheese frosting that ties it all together. Moist, comforting, and just sweet enough, it's the cake that feels like a treat and a tradition at the same time. A quiet favorite that always wins people over.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
items.description: Bright, zesty, and finished with a sweet lemon glaze that soaks into every layer — this cake is sunshine on a plate. The tang of fresh lemon zest cuts through the sweetness for a cake that's refreshing rather than heavy. Perfect with afternoon tea or any time you need a lift.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh same-day, ready in 2–3 hours

items.name: Custom Birthday Cake
items.description: Your vision, our craft — this fully personalized cake is designed around your theme, colors, and message, made from scratch just for your celebration. From superheroes to elegant florals, our team works with you via WhatsApp to bring the exact cake you're picturing to life. Because the best birthdays deserve a cake as unique as the person celebrating.
items.prepInfo: Made to order — 24hr notice required, design consultation via WhatsApp

items.name: Mini Cupcake Assortment (12pcs)
items.description: A little bit of everything — 12 bite-sized cupcakes in a rotating mix of flavors, each one frosted and finished with its own personality. Perfect for parties where everyone wants something different, or for indecisive cupcake lovers who can't pick just one. Small in size, big on variety.

items.name: Fresh Orange Juice
items.description: Squeezed fresh the moment you order — no concentrate, no shortcuts, just real oranges turned into pure, sun-bright juice. Naturally sweet, packed with vitamin C, and the kind of refresh that actually wakes you up. Simple, honest, and always in season.

items.name: Mango Smoothie
items.description: Ripe, golden mango blended thick and creamy with milk and yogurt for a smoothie that tastes like tropical sunshine in a cup. Cold, smooth, and naturally sweet — no added sugar needed when the mango's this good. A rotating favorite for a reason.

items.name: Passion Fruit Juice
items.description: Bold, tangy, and unmistakably tropical — real passion fruit blended fresh for that sharp-sweet punch you can't get from a carton. It's the juice that wakes up your taste buds and keeps you coming back for the next sip.

items.name: Pineapple Mint Juice
items.description: Sweet pineapple meets cool, fresh mint for a juice that tastes like a beach breeze in a glass. Light, refreshing, and just the right amount of zing — perfect for hot afternoons or whenever you need a reset.

items.name: Vanilla Milkshake
items.description: Thick, cold, and unapologetically classic — real vanilla ice cream blended smooth with milk and vanilla syrup for that nostalgic milkshake experience. Simple done exceptionally well, straw included.

items.name: Strawberry Smoothie
items.description: Fresh strawberries blended creamy with milk and yogurt for a smoothie that's naturally sweet, satisfyingly thick, and bursting with fruity flavor in every sip. A best-seller that never goes out of style.

items.name: Chocolate Milkshake
items.description: Rich chocolate syrup and chocolate ice cream blended into a thick, cold shake topped with a swirl of cream — this is chocolate done right. Decadent, smooth, and the perfect companion to anything on the menu.

items.name: Iced Coffee
items.description: Bold espresso, cold milk, and plenty of ice — this is the coffee fix for anyone who needs their caffeine cold, smooth, and no-nonsense. Brewed fresh to order, never sitting around getting stale.
items.prepInfo: Brewed and prepared fresh to order

items.name: Hot Cappuccino
items.description: Rich espresso topped with a thick layer of steamed milk foam, brewed fresh for that perfect balance of bold and creamy. The kind of cappuccino that makes slowing down for five minutes worth it.

items.name: Bottled Water (500ml)
items.description: Clean, cold, and simple — pure drinking water for whenever you just need to stay refreshed. No frills, just the essentials.

items.name: Cheese Danish
items.description: Flaky, golden layers of buttery pastry wrapped around a rich, tangy cream cheese filling. Baked fresh daily until the edges turn perfectly crisp and the inside stays soft and creamy — a breakfast classic done right.

items.name: Chocolate Croissant
items.description: Buttery, flaky croissant pastry wrapped around a generous core of dark chocolate that turns molten-soft the moment it's warmed. Crisp on the outside, rich and gooey within — the pastry that makes mornings worth getting up for.

items.name: Apple Turnover
items.description: Sweet, cinnamon-spiced apples wrapped in golden, flaky puff pastry that shatters with every bite. Baked fresh daily for that perfect contrast of crisp pastry and warm, soft fruit filling.

items.name: Almond Croissant
items.description: A classic croissant taken further — filled with rich almond paste, topped with sliced almonds, and baked until deeply golden. Nutty, buttery, and just sweet enough, it's a bakery-counter favorite for a reason.

items.name: Chocolate Eclair
items.description: Light choux pastry filled with smooth cream and finished with a glossy chocolate glaze — this eclair is soft, rich, and elegantly simple. Baked and filled fresh daily so every bite stays perfectly light.

items.name: Cinnamon Roll
items.description: Soft, pillowy dough swirled with buttery cinnamon sugar and finished with a generous drizzle of icing. Warm, comforting, and best-selling for good reason — this is the roll that makes any morning better.

items.name: Fruit Tart
items.description: A crisp pastry shell filled with silky custard and topped with a vibrant arrangement of fresh seasonal fruit. Light, elegant, and as beautiful to look at as it is to eat.
items.prepInfo: Baked fresh daily, assembled with seasonal fruit

items.name: Pecan Pie Slice
items.description: Buttery pastry crust filled with rich caramel and toasted pecans, baked until perfectly set and satisfyingly gooey. A rich, nutty treat for anyone who loves a proper Southern-style dessert.

items.name: Blueberry Muffin
items.description: Soft, moist muffin packed with plump blueberries that burst with every bite. Baked fresh daily with a lightly golden top — simple, comforting, and always reliable.

items.name: Lemon Tart
items.description: A crisp, buttery pastry shell filled with silky, tangy lemon curd that's bright, zesty, and perfectly balanced. Small in size but big on flavor — the tart that cuts through the sweetness of everything else on the table.

bundles.name: Birthday Combo
bundles.description: Everything you need for a celebration in one order — a full 1kg cake of your choice, 6 soft cupcakes, and a fresh juice to round it off. Baked and prepared fresh the same day, this combo turns any birthday into a full spread without the hassle of ordering separately.

bundles.name: Family Treat Pack
bundles.description: A full chocolate cake, 4 assorted drinks, and a side of fries — built for movie nights, family catch-ups, or just because everyone deserves a treat sometimes. Prepared fresh and ready to share.

bundles.name: Weekend Chill Bundle
bundles.description: Your choice of cake, 2 drinks, and a mix of fresh pastries — the ultimate lineup for a slow, easy weekend at home. Everything prepared fresh the same day so you can just relax and enjoy.

bundles.name: Morning Boost Pack
bundles.description: Fresh juice paired with a pastry of your choice — the simple, satisfying combo to kickstart your morning without overdoing it. Prepared fresh to order, every time.

bundles.name: Couple's Delight Bundle
bundles.description: Chocolate cake, cupcakes, and two drinks — designed for date nights, anniversaries, or any excuse to treat yourselves together. A little indulgence made for sharing.

bundles.name: Family Movie Night
bundles.description: A cake of your choice, popcorn, and 4 drinks — everything you need to turn screen time into an event. Prepared fresh same-day so movie night actually feels special.

bundles.name: Tea Time Special
bundles.description: A pastry of your choice paired with tea or coffee — the perfect quiet-afternoon combo for slowing down and enjoying a proper break. Simple, satisfying, and always fresh.

bundles.name: Kids Birthday Pack
bundles.description: A mini cake, cupcakes, and juice sized just right for a kids' celebration — colorful, fun, and built to make the birthday child feel like the star. Baked and prepared fresh the same day.

faqs.q: How much notice do you need for custom cakes?
faqs.a: Custom cakes need at least 24 hours notice. Standard cakes and bundles are baked fresh same-day.

faqs.q: Can I customize the flavor or size?
faqs.a: Yes — message us on WhatsApp with your preferred flavor, size, and design and we'll confirm availability and pricing.

faqs.q: Do you deliver, or is it pickup only?
faqs.a: We offer both. Delivery details and timing are confirmed directly over WhatsApp once your order is placed.

faqs.q: How should I store my order?
faqs.a: Cakes and pastries are best enjoyed within 1–2 days. Keep cakes refrigerated if not eating the same day, and bring to room temperature before serving.

faqs.q: Do you cater for allergies or dietary needs?
faqs.a: Check the allergen list on each product. For specific dietary needs (eggless, nut-free, etc.), message us on WhatsApp before ordering.
